page.overview:
Who is Backwards Snoke?

Backwards Snoke was a humanoid male clone of Snoke who was created by the Sith Eternal cult on the planet Exegol. His cloning process was unsuccessful which left him with a reversed head and backwards speech.

Backwards Snoke first appeared in the 2022 non-canon video game LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga, in the side mission "Attack of the Clones (Again)".
